Needs changes before merge.

The catalog adds the 16 tools from #3036. The existing entries retain their values and order. The MCP test lists the new tools and adds each one by name.

## Local results

I trial-merged the PR with upstream main at `582981bfa92d208087eeed9e148dde045975a3c1`.

- Quick gate passed. `tools suites: lib` passed 122 tests. `app suites: mcp` passed 49 tests.
- Clippy passed for all targets of `camcraft-tools` and `camcraft-app` with warnings denied.
- The five release-mode light suites passed. The motion library passed 7 tests. `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, and `pocket_pass_start` passed 1 test each.

### Extra suites run

| App suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `example_catalog` | 41 passed, 4 ignored heavy tests |
| `example_catalog_adaptive` | 1 passed |
| `example_catalog_edge_work` | 1 passed |
| `golden_cl` | 34 passed |
| `posting` | 17 passed |

This change adds starter tool data. It leaves the post, geometry, gouge check, collision check, and stock simulation code unchanged. The diff has no golden changes. Safety mutations and heavy tests did not apply.

## Requested before merge

1. PR description, line 45. Move or remove the generated footer so that the last line is `Fixes #3036`. See “Pull Request Law” in [upstream AGENTS.md](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/582981bfa92d208087eeed9e148dde045975a3c1/AGENTS.md#L311-L319).

## Optional, non-blocking

- `crates/app/tests/mcp.rs:322` adds 21 lines to an 842-line test file.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Hi @shadaytree, welcome, and thank you for the catalog tools. The code review is clean. Only one small change is necessary, in the PR description (not the code):

1. Edit the PR description. Move the line `🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)` above `Fixes #3036`, or delete it. The last line of the description must be `Fixes #3036`.
2. Click **Ready for review** at the bottom of the PR.

No new push is necessary. When the PR is ready, our reviewer checks it again, and then it can merge. The comment about the 842-line `mcp.rs` file is optional, and you can ignore it for this PR.

Maintainer edit (at the maintainer's request): I moved the generated footer above `Fixes #3036`, so the last line is now `Fixes #3036`, and I marked the PR ready for review. The code is unchanged (head `754a5cb23`). The reviewer now checks it again.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 754a5cb23e9df30471f51bd693efb3676e8d09d8 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge at the next cut.

## Previous finding

1. PR description footer — fixed. The last line is `Fixes #3036`. The maintainer [recorded the edit](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3916#issuecomment-7146780755). The head is unchanged.

The catalog adds the 16 tools from #3036. I compared the catalog rows with upstream main. The 38 existing entries keep their values and order. The MCP test lists and adds each new tool by name.

## Local results

I trial-merged this head with upstream main at `33597a2fb705569fe5c9cbda1c1c0af0e5897d20`.

- Quick gate passed. The tools library passed 122 tests. The app `mcp` suite passed 49 tests.
- Clippy passed for all targets in `camcraft-tools` and `camcraft-app` with warnings denied.
- The release build for the light gate passed. The motion library passed 7 light tests. The `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, and `pocket_pass_start` suites passed 1 light test each.

### Extra suites run

| App suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `example_catalog` | 41 passed, 4 ignored heavy tests |
| `example_catalog_adaptive` | 1 passed |
| `example_catalog_edge_work` | 1 passed |
| `golden_cl` | 34 passed |
| `posting` | 17 passed |

The PR adds starter tool data and tests. The diff has no changes to recorded programs or goldens. Safety mutations and heavy lanes did not apply.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Follow-ups (file after merge)

- P7, commit message format. Document where the `Co-Authored-By` trailer goes when the fixing commit must end with `Fixes #N`. This head already had the trailer after `Fixes #3036` at the first review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

left for the maintainer: feat PR waiting for the next cut, and outside contributor (shadaytree is not a collaborator on NeoTech/Camcraft). Counted clean review (mkinney, at head `754a5cb23`) is noted; it does not change these rules.
